paragraphs.text:
Once  engaged,  Charlie  watches  your  eyes  as  if  hypnotized. 
After  a  long  talk,  she  shrugs,  pained.  “You  speak  the  truth, 
Professor.  Sometimes  the  legends  of  my  people  are  just  stories.  I 
am… rational, like you.” She stands up and begins to look for 
the missing student.

Make a Track roll for Charlie: if it succeeds, go to 23; if it fails, go 
to 24.
